bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
root="$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot"
cd "$root"
test -d .git || exit 61
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 62
test "$(systemctl --user is-enabled gace-userbot-verify.service)" = enabled || exit 63
tmp="$(mktemp -d /tmp/gace-link-photo-ast.XXXXXXXX)"
files=(scripts/userbot_test_client.py scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py)
for i in "${!files[@]}"; do
 f="${files[$i]}"
 test -f "$f" && test ! -L "$f" || exit $((64+i))
 cp "$f" "$tmp/old$i.py"
done
python3 - "$tmp" <<'PY'
import ast
from pathlib import Path
import sys
root=Path(sys.argv[1])
for i in range(2):
 source=(root/f"old{i}.py").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
 tree=ast.parse(source)
 matches=[]
 for n in ast.walk(tree):
  if not isinstance(n,ast.IfExp) or not isinstance(n.test,ast.Compare):
   continue
  for comp in n.test.comparators:
   if not isinstance(comp,ast.Set):continue
   vals={e.value for e in comp.elts if isinstance(e,ast.Constant) and isinstance(e.value,str)}
   if {"link_registration_smoke","link_rich_flow_smoke"}<=vals:
    matches.append((comp,vals))
 if len(matches)!=1:
  raise SystemExit(74+i)
 comp,vals=matches[0]
 if "link_photo_caption_smoke" not in vals:
  lines=source.splitlines(keepends=True)
  if comp.lineno!=comp.end_lineno:raise SystemExit(76+i)
  line=lines[comp.lineno-1]
  fragment=line[comp.col_offset:comp.end_col_offset]
  if not (fragment.startswith("{") and fragment.endswith("}")):raise SystemExit(78+i)
  updated=fragment[:-1]+', "link_photo_caption_smoke"}'
  lines[comp.lineno-1]=line[:comp.col_offset]+updated+line[comp.end_col_offset:]
  source="".join(lines)
 compile(source,f"new{i}.py","exec")
 (root/f"new{i}.py").write_text(source,encoding="utf-8")
PY
swapped=0
passed=0
cleanup(){
 rc=$?
 trap - EXIT
 if test "$swapped" = 1 && test "$passed" != 1; then
  for i in "${!files[@]}"; do cp "$tmp/old$i.py" "${files[$i]}" || true; done
  systemctl --user restart gace-userbot-verify.service || true
 fi
 rm -rf "$tmp"
 exit "$rc"
}
trap cleanup EXIT
for i in "${!files[@]}"; do cp "$tmp/new$i.py" "${files[$i]}"; done
swapped=1
systemctl --user restart gace-userbot-verify.service || exit 80
ready=0
for i in $(seq 1 15); do
 if test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active && python3 scripts/userbot_test_client.py health >/dev/null 2>&1; then ready=1; break; fi
 sleep 2
done
test "$ready" = 1 || exit 81
test "$(systemctl --user is-enabled gace-userbot-verify.service)" = enabled || exit 82
passed=1
echo PHOTO_TIMEOUT_AST_PATCH=PASS
echo USERBOT_SESSION_HEALTH=PASS
